column2: [intro]
I’ve got a distant look, that’s my specialty,
Everyone’s watching, I’m a comic star, you see!
I make funny faces, I’m always in a trance,
People keep asking, “Who’s this dance?”
Distant gaze, I don’t bite, I promise,
Distant gaze, come dance with me, it’s honest.
No one’s bored when I’m around,
With my distant look, I break all bounds, yeah!
I stroll down the street, with my funky shades,
Everyone's staring, wondering what I’ve made.
But I don’t care, I’m in my enchanted land,
Playing with words, making folks laugh, it’s grand.
Distant gaze, I don’t bite, I promise,
Distant gaze, come dance with me, it’s honest.
No one’s bored when I’m around,
With my distant look, I break all bounds, yeah!
[ solo ]
Come on, everyone, show me your distant stare,
We’ll party, laugh, and dance without a care,
With my humor and my fun, life’s always bright,
With me, no need for seriousness, let’s enjoy the night!
[outro]
